summary: The team is pivoting to prioritize China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving IT lockout issues.
summaryDetail: The most urgent focus this week is resolving the Outlook account lockout across all devices, which requires deleting and re-adding accounts and confirming backend unlock with JSB. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has chosen to keep the current design with menu categorization improvements, incorporate BCI/BSI indices, and disperse videos by topic; a working session is needed to finalize feedback and make design changes. Program promotion is shifting to Asia Star and Intelligent China as top priorities, with the Berkeley program as a potential third, while US partnerships (Stanford, Columbia) are on hold for Q1. Upcoming actions include drafting a target audience document for search visibility, analyzing participant profiles and CRM leads, and providing a Google Analytics conversion tracking brief. Later in the year, attention will turn to updating event materials for Professor Xiaomeng's revised speech topic, finalizing the Western MBA faculty training press release, and following up on Stanford enrollment leads.
